purpose: Retained MXF graph allocations; independent of database-first scheduling policy.

provenance.execution: Isolated x86_64 C++17 reader probes under Rosetta on macOS; Qt6.5.3; unoptimized builds. Three real media files opened read-only, keeping each parsed graph alive. No whole-drive scan in this probe.
provenance.beforeAndAfterHeaderCompatibility: Both reader versions compiled against the same current headers, including the concurrently added ParsedSource.readReason; neither probe links the old static library.
provenance.fingerprintScope: SHA-256 of QDataStream serialization of outcome/container/diagnostics, object handles/roles/identities, MXF set contexts, property locators/ranges/encodings/decoded values/states/interpretations/text encoding/native MXF context, and relationship endpoints/locators/references/basis/explanations. Excludes capacities, pointer addresses, source snapshots, and scan scheduling readReason. This is a parsed-graph conservation check, not a whole-file checksum.
provenance.rssSource: mach_task_basic_info.resident_size. Final snapshots follow graph fingerprint serialization, whose temporary allocation can affect retained allocator pages.

repeatedTextSample.measurement: UTF-16 character payload bytes counted once per distinct QString.constData pointer; excludes allocator headers and unused character capacity; includes shared literals. Counts are not heap-allocation byte totals.

testResult.regression: retainedGraphsUseCompactSharedStorage checks capacity, shared repeated text, distinct encoded/decoded names, and exact reference origins/targets; existing real fixtures check retained bytes against source ranges.

wholeScanBeforeReference.note: Separate root-agent full-scan run of the prior eager-header binary, supplied as baseline context. It is not this three-file probe, and no after full-scan claim is made here.

caveats: Three representative files do not establish a universal per-file cost.
RSS depends on architecture, allocator reuse and transient allocations; the first-file RSS increase was larger after compaction. These changes do not guarantee a lower peak.
Exact dictionary-object payloads did not match across these samples when original InstanceUID and reference values were included; whole dictionaries must not be merged by assumption.
Raw essence bytes remain skipped. Every metadata property and reference retained before these changes remains retained.
Database-first reading, separately approved by the user, avoids building header graphs where database evidence satisfies required metadata. Its full-scan effect is reported separately.
